description: What Lyra's AI may never say, in one file. ADVICE blocks a whole answer - there is no safe half of an instruction to trade. A PREDICTION removes the sentence that makes it. A PRICE CALL (a forecast of a share price) removes a briefing item. Read today by workers/stock_scanner/ai_read_guard.py and briefing_guard.py; written in the regex both Python and JavaScript read the same way (no lookbehind, no named groups, no inline flags) so the app's chat guard can read the same file. 'flags' is 'i' (ignore case) or '' (case matters - used where a capital letter is the signal: a sentence that opens with an instruction, or a ticker). Widened on 2026-11-06, when Lyra's free features moved to open-weight models: a smaller model writes 'Buy SPOT now' or 'investors should consider adding' where a frontier model did not. The rules describe advice TO THE READER. Company news is full of the same verbs used as facts - 'is considering selling a stake', 'we need to add capacity', 'a loan guarantee', 'investors must wait for the decision' - and must pass; the test sentences pin both sides.
